projects.title: Home Server
projects.description: Proxmox home server HDD rack in the style of a Synology NAS. Currently hosting a media server, a file server, and most importantly a Minecraft server. Designed in Fusion 360 and printed in PLA & PETG.

projects.title: TTRPG Dice Trays
projects.description:
A large dice tray for TTRPGs such as D&D with a collapsable dice tower, multiple dice areas, and spell slot trackers.

Mini dice trays for taking dice sets on the go.

Designed in Fusion 360 and 3d printed in PLA. Fastened with magnets and lined with wool felt.

projects.title: TTRPG Accessories
projects.description:
Dice capsules for super portable dice storage.

Miniature tokens for tactical combat on the grid without the trouble.

A fabric dice bag.

Designed in Fusion 360 and printed in PLA where applicable. Magnet fasteners and acrylic paint where applicable.

projects.title: Finger-board
projects.description: An elevation of the classic tech deck concept with the star in the lineup being the combination quarter pipe, ledge, hubba, and deck storage obstacle. Supported by more traditional obstacles, all designed in fusion360, printed in PLA, and magnets used where applicable.

projects.title: Distortion Pedal
projects.description: A custom designed and manufactured guitar distortion pedal based on the [Bass Fuzz](https://home-wrecker.com/bazz.html) circuit. KiCad used for circuit design with PCB manufactured at the University of Glasgow.

projects.title: Ondes Martenot
projects.description:
A current work in progress.

One of the original electronic instruments which utilises a ring controler to adjust pitch and a throttle to adjust attack. Controls for adjusting octave up and down as well as choice of sine wave, saw wave, triangle wave, and square wave.

Enclosure designed in Fusion 360 and printed in PLA.

projects.title: MIDI Slider
projects.description:
A musical instrument using a binary combination of four linear potentiometers to determine pitch.

Designed in collaboration with William Murrison in Fusion 360 with software developed in Python.

projects.title: Rhobot
projects.description:
RhoBot is a mobile robot for research in obstacle avoidance built using an NVIDIA Jetson Nano, a Slamtec A1M8 RPLiDAR, a Raspberry Pi Cam v2, and two Parallax CR serco motors. The enclosure was designed with Fusion 360 and printed in PLA and the PCB was designed in KiCad. The software was developed in C.

The pull project details can be found in the [project's repository](https://github.com/jcr3/rhobot).
